entries.german: Graf Heinrich von Werdenberg 1 genehmigt den Verkauf von Gütern ans Prämonstratenserkloster Weissenau 2 durch seine Brüder Hugo und Albrecht 3 ... Actum aput oppidum Rinegge 4 in strata publica presentibus supradicto Hugone comite de Werdenberg fratre nostro, Egelolffo de Rosenberg 5 milite, Cůnrado de Richenuelse 6, Eberhardo dicto Helt, Růdolffo advocato de Wartense 7, V olrico dicto de Ho ehst 8 ministro in Rinegge, Hainrico de A emtz 9, Cůnrado ministro de Pregantia 10, Růdolffo dicto Hůrsche, Cůnrado dicto Biggel.. ., et Constantie consumatum atque datum ...
entries.english: Count Heinrich von Werdenberg approves the sale of properties to the Premonstratensian monastery at Weissenau by his brothers Hugo and Albrecht. ... Enacted at the town of Rinegge, in the public street, in the presence of the aforementioned Hugo, count von Werdenberg, our brother; Egelolf von Rosenberg, Ritter; Cunrad von Richenwels; Eberhard called Helt; Rudolf, bailiff von Wartensee; Volrich called von Höchst, minister at Rinegge; Heinrich von Aemtz; Cunrad, minister at Bregenz; Rudolf called Hürsche; Cunrad called Biggel...; and [the transaction] was completed and issued at Constance ...
